'''Skogres''' are skeletal [[ogre]]s encountered during the [[Zogre Flesh Eaters]] quest, and can be found in [[Jiggig]] and [[Jiggig Dungeon]] south-east of [[Castle Wars]].

A skogre may also appear when burying [[zogre bones]], or any variant of zogre bones (such as [[raurg bones]]) inside [[Jiggig]]. This skogre is always aggressive to the player regardless of combat level.

==Strengths and weaknesses==
Skogres are almost immune to normal weapons (you will hit just as often, but damage is reduced by 75%).{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1747570723487461880|date=17 January 2024|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/99577|archivedate=18 January 2024|quote=Damage divided by 4. I didn't see any sign of a floor.}} [[Brutal arrows]] are effective against them, as is the [[Crumble Undead]] spell (however, damage is halved, for a maximum of 7). The [[salve amulet]] and its variants are effective against Skogres as they are undead.

Skogres are also capable of infecting the player with [[disease]]. Disease can be cured with [[Sanfew serum]] or [[Relicym's balm]], the latter of which may be bought from [[Uglug Nar]] outside Jiggig for {{Coins|200}}. An [[inoculation bracelet]] will prevent damage taken from disease, but will not grant immunity to becoming diseased.
